description: A 28-second scripted fly-around of an apple tree on a small grass terrace cut into a hillside by the sea, with an L-shaped wooden fence (with a gate) running up to the tree's trunk. 0:00-0:12 the tree close up, 0:12-0:22 the fence, its gate, its corner and far end, 0:22-0:28 the tree from above.
